title: Tsang Loo Zung

page_data.en:
Form 2
Shanghai Municipal Police.
357
30/5/16
Central Police Station.
18th May 1918
REPORT ON attached letter re a Peace Conference.
Made by D.S.I.Brewster Forwarded by
Sir
The office of the Chinese Peace Conference to which the
attached letter refers, is located in a small filthy upstairs
room at No 605 Honan Road. The only occupant is an
old man named Tsang Loo Zung 張露澄 a Native of Szechuen and an
ex-Official. He explained that he started the movement for a
conference himself and succeeded in interesting the other promoters
who appear to be respectable although not prominent members of
the Chinese community. The aim of the movement is the reconci_
liation of the North and South, irrespective of Party, and the cess_
ation of hostilities. No subscriptions are asked for and the
Society appears to be a genuine one although its aims may be some_
what far fetched.
Your Obedient Servant
WBrewster.
D.S.I.
Chief Det Insp.
10 d

16年5月30日
中央捕房。
1918年5月18日
关于所附有关和平会议信件的报告。
由首席副督察布鲁斯特（Brewster）呈报

敬启者：

所附信件提及的“中国和平会议”办事处，位于河南路605号一间狭小肮脏的楼上房间内。该处唯一的居住者是一位名叫张露澄（Tsang Loo Zung）的老者，系四川籍前清官员。他解释说，发起此次会议运动的是他本人，并成功引起了其他发起人的兴趣；这些发起人虽非华人社群中的显赫人物，但看似体面人士。该运动的宗旨是不分党派，调和南北双方，停止敌对行动。该会不募集捐款，且看起来是一个真实的团体，尽管其目标可能有些异想天开。

您忠实的仆人
W. Brewster.
首席副督察
首席侦缉督察

Form 81.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CAPTAIN SUPERINTENDENT'S OFFICE.

Translation of a letter from the Business Office of Chinese Peace Conference addressed to the Chief Inspector of Police.

by Drot-
Undated. 191
(Received 16-5-1916).

The Chief Inspector of Police,
Central Police Station.

Sir,

Fighting has taken place between the South and North and owing to the different opinions of the parties we are promoting a Chinese Peace Conference for the purpose of devising ways to exhort the parties, stop the fighting and maintain good order, and the peace & good order of the Settlement (or Settlements) will never be obstructed or interferred with.

The following are names and descriptions of 5 promotors:-

Zung Ming Yuen(陳明遠), Taotai of Canton in Tsing Dynasty.
Has been a certain adviser in Japan & a Director of Kweichow Mining business.

Tsang Loo Dzung(張羅澄), An ex-official of the 4th rank and has been doing business in Shanghai for over 4 years and he has changed his name to Tsang Ngoo Chuen(張吾軍).

Yau Ming Zung(姚明仁), A gentleman of Shanghai Hsien.

Siau Ping Yien(蕭炳炎), A salt merchant of Szechuen.

Kao Dzoon Lee (高崇禮), a mining merchant of Chekiang.

(Stamped) Business Office of the Chinese
Peace Conference.
※ (C/O Yung Oo Ziang Hong, corner )
(of Chaotung & Honan Roads. )

A copy of manifesto attached.

C.S.I.
* Is this aggressive place?
a.m.
16/5-

（印：S.M.P. HEAD QUARTERS OFFICE - CHINA 16 MAY 1916）

表格 81。

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警司办公室。

中国和平会议事务处致警务处总督察的信函译文。

由 Drot-
无日期。191
（1916年5月16日收悉）。

警务处总督察，
中央捕房。

敬启者：

南北之间已发生战事，鉴于各方意见不一，我们正推动召开中国和平会议，旨在设法劝诫各方，停止战斗，维持良好秩序，且绝不会妨碍或干扰租界（或各租界）的和平与良好秩序。

以下是五位发起人的姓名及履历：

陈明远（Zung Ming Yuen），清代广东道台。
曾任日本某顾问及贵州矿业公司董事。

张罗澄（Tsang Loo Dzung），四品前清官员，在上海经商四年有余，现已改名为张吾军（Tsang Ngoo Chuen）。

姚明仁（Yau Ming Zung），上海县绅士。

萧炳炎（Siau Ping Yien），四川盐商。

高崇礼（Kao Dzoon Lee），浙江矿商。

（盖章）中国和平会议
事务处。
※（由永源祥号转交，地址：）
（兆通路与河南路转角。）

随函附上宣言副本一份。

首席副督察
* 此地点是否具有侵略性？
上午
16/5-

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处总部 - 中国 1916年5月16日）
